approval.note: reviewed; 5-run stability report shows 100% identical outputs

name: Look up savings balance
description: Looks up a member by number and reads their current savings balance.

parameters.name: member_number
parameters.description: Value entered into the 'Member number' field.

outputs.name: savings_balance
outputs.description: The member's Savings account balance, read from the account detail table via next_cell 'Savings' (the <td> after the 'Savings' type cell).

success_condition.description: The output selector (text_contains 'Savings') must resolve on the final page: if the value can be read, the flow reached its end state.
